title: TD Social: tapping any chat alert opens that exact chat
text: A tap on a WhatsApp or email alert from the lock screen used to open only the WhatsApp or Inbox tab. It now opens the conversation. Internal team threads and chats with a person who has no company now open on the exact chat too. This works with the app you already have.
points: Email alert opens that email, in the right mailbox
Internal team thread and no-company chats open on the exact chat
stepsTitle: Opening a chat from the lock screen

steps.name: Lock the phone and get an alert
steps.detail: A WhatsApp message or an email arrives.

steps.name: Tap the alert
steps.detail: The app opens on that conversation.
